tool.name: Multimodal Learner
tool.description: Train and evaluate an AutoGluon Multimodal model

exit_code.description: Error occurred. Please check Tool Standard Error

tool.command:
#import re #if $input_csv #set $sanitized_input_csv = re.sub('[^\\w\\-_\\.]','_', $input_csv.element_identifier.strip()) ln -sf '$input_csv' "./${sanitized_input_csv}"; #end if #if $input_test #set $sanitized_test_csv = re.sub('[^\\w\\-_\\.]','_', $input_test.element_identifier.strip()) ln -sf '$input_test' "./${sanitized_test_csv}"; #end if
python '$__tool_directory__/multimodal_learner.py' --input_csv_train "./${sanitized_input_csv}" #if $input_test: --input_csv_test "./${sanitized_test_csv}" #end if --target_column '$target_column' #if str($use_images_conditional.use_images) == 'yes': #if $use_images_conditional.image_column: --image_column '$use_images_conditional.image_column' #end if #if $use_images_conditional.images_zip: --images_zip '$use_images_conditional.images_zip' #end if #end if #if $random_seed is not None: --random_seed '$random_seed' #end if #if $time_limit: --time_limit $time_limit #end if #if $validation_size is not None: --validation_size $validation_size #end if #if $split_probabilities: --split_probabilities ${",".join([p.strip() for p in $split_probabilities.split(",")])} #end if #if $val_size_with_test is not None: --val_size_with_test $val_size_with_test #end if --output_csv '$output_csv' --output_json '$output_json' --output_html '$output_html' &&
mkdir -p '$output_model.extra_files_path' &&
MODEL_DIR_FILE='predictor_path.txt' if [ -f "$MODEL_DIR_FILE" ]; then MODEL_DIR="$(cat "$MODEL_DIR_FILE" | tr -d '\r\n')" else MODEL_DIR='' fi
if [ -n "$MODEL_DIR" ] && [ -d "$MODEL_DIR" ]; then cp -r "$MODEL_DIR"/* "$output_model.extra_files_path"/ else if [ -d 'AutogluonModels' ]; then cp -r AutogluonModels "$output_model.extra_files_path"/AutogluonModels fi if [ -d 'experiment_run/model' ]; then cp -r experiment_run/model "$output_model.extra_files_path"/ 2>/dev/null || true fi ls *.pkl *.ckpt *.json *.yaml *.yml *.log *.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && \ cp -r *.pkl *.ckpt *.json *.yaml *.yml *.log *.txt "$output_model.extra_files_path" 2>/dev/null || true fi &&
echo 'Multimodal Learner experiment is done!'

param.name: input_csv
param.label: Multimodal input dataset
param.help: CSV with features (and optional image paths)

param.name: input_test
param.label: Multimodal Test dataset
param.help: If omitted, a split is created from the input dataset

param.name: val_size_with_test
param.label: Validation fraction (when test CSV is provided)

tool.help: **AutoGluon Multimodal Learner** Trains and evaluates an AutoGluon MultiModal model using tabular data and, optionally, images.
